name: mz-dbt-release
description: Cut a dbt-materialize PyPI release: bump the version in `__version__.py` and `setup.py`, date the `Unreleased` CHANGELOG entry, and open the release PR with a `Ship: <url>` body. Trigger: "cut a dbt release", "release dbt-materialize", "release the dbt adapter", "ship dbt-materialize vX.Y.Z", "publish dbt-materialize to PyPI", "bump dbt-materialize version", "new dbt adapter version". Use this skill even if the user just says "ship the dbt adapter" or pastes a feature PR and asks for "the next dbt release" without naming version mechanics.
